# Final self-review checks on subtle protocol points
import sys, json, subprocess
def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())

# 1. prepending becomes adjacent after IXP removal
doc = {"version":1,"ixps":[99],"rib":[{"path":[10,99,10,20],"count":1}],
       "priors":[],"declared":[],"order":[],"queries":[{"id":"p","path":[10,99,10,20],"threshold":[1,2]}]}
r = run(doc)
print("ixp-prepending path:", r['queries'][0]['path'], r['links'])

# 2. RIB loop discarded, contributes no links
doc = {"version":1,"ixps":[],"rib":[{"path":[1,2,1],"count":5}],
       "priors":[],"declared":[],"order":[],"queries":[]}
print("looped rib links:", run(doc))

       "queries":[{"id":"l","path":[5,99,5,6,5],"threshold":[1,2]}]}

       "declared":[{"link":[77,88],"rel":"p2c"}],"order":[],
       "queries":[{"id":"d","path":[77,88,89],"threshold":[1,2]}]}

       "queries":[{"id":"z","path":[7,7,7],"threshold":[0,1]}]}
